title: Ternary Cord Transposer
description: A dry alien nerve-cord transposition yard. Salvaged neural cable is quarantined in a folded capture lock, individually tension-tested, repositioned by a three-prong roof-supported transplant gate above a Midge-enterable registering bench, dry-annealed and packed onto an orthographic twin-spool recovery dock. Two accessible underfloor diagnostic vaults, real cardinal flight paths, no water, falling matter or illustrative-only scenery.
districts: Folded quarantine lock, ribbed scrub trays and entered lower receiver
Angled live-cord sorting and tension testing, separate floor calibration tools
Three-prong transposition crown and physically entered grounded registering station
Asymmetric dry annealing gills and segmented process sample readouts
Two radial braced winding wheels, seven packed cargo cassettes, service dock
